title: Temp files and junk
desc: Windows and user temp folders, crash dumps, error reports, old memory dumps.

title: Browser caches
desc: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Firefox caches. Open browsers are skipped. Logins and history stay.

title: Empty Recycle Bin
desc: Permanently deletes what is in the Recycle Bin.

title: Free standby RAM
desc: Purges the standby cache so games load into clean memory.

title: Page file sized from your RAM
desc: Lets Windows size virtual memory from installed RAM. Fixes disabled or too-small page files that cause stutter and crashes.

title: Max performance power plan
desc: Ultimate Performance plan, CPU at 100% minimum state, core parking off, USB, PCIe and Wi-Fi power saving off. Laptops and X3D chips get the safe equivalent.

title: Power throttling off
desc: Stops Windows from slowing down processes it thinks are in the background.

title: Game Mode
desc: Windows prioritizes the game and pauses update installs while you play.

title: Game scheduling profile
desc: Multimedia scheduler gives games higher CPU, GPU and disk priority and removes network throttling.

title: Most-played games on high performance
desc: Your top Steam, Epic and Riot games get the high performance GPU and high CPU priority.

title: Memory Integrity off
desc: Removes virtualization overhead in games. Lowers protection against kernel-level malware.

title: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
desc: The GPU manages its own memory. Lower latency and required for DLSS Frame Generation.

title: NVIDIA performance profile
desc: Prefer maximum performance, Low Latency Mode On, texture filtering High performance.

title: Cap FPS for G-SYNC
desc: Caps frame rate at refresh rate minus 3 for tear-free, low-latency G-SYNC. Leave off for uncapped competitive play.

title: AMD Radeon settings
desc: Anti-Lag, FreeSync and performance texture settings checklist for AMD Adrenalin.

title: GPU driver check
desc: Flags NVIDIA, AMD or Intel drivers older than 90 days with a one-click update link.

title: Highest refresh rate
desc: Switches every monitor to the highest refresh rate it supports.

title: VRR and windowed game optimizations
desc: Variable refresh rate for games, plus flip-model presentation for borderless and windowed games on Windows 11.

title: Visual effects for performance
desc: Performance Options set for max FPS: animations, shadows and fades off. Smooth fonts and thumbnails stay.

title: Transparency effects off
desc: Removes blur and transparency from the taskbar, Start and windows.

title: Stop startup apps
desc: Disables apps that launch with Windows. Drivers, security, peripherals and anti-cheat are kept.

title: Background apps and telemetry
desc: Store apps cannot run in the background, Widgets off (News and interests on Windows 10), telemetry and unused services set to Manual.

title: Stop useless background processes
desc: Stops updaters, telemetry and idle helpers such as Phone Link, Game Bar, Cortana and Adobe helpers, sets updater services to Manual and turns off Windows telemetry tasks. Anything with an open window is left alone.

title: Game overlays off
desc: Xbox Game Bar recording off, plus a checklist for Steam, Discord, NVIDIA and AMD overlays.

title: Notifications off
desc: No pop-up notifications or Windows tips over your game.

title: Discord hardware acceleration off
desc: Discord stops using the GPU, leaving it to your game.

title: Browsers stop running in background
desc: Chrome and Edge fully close when you close them. Edge no longer preloads at boot.

title: Browser hardware acceleration off
desc: Chrome and Edge stop using the GPU. Video playback moves to the CPU, so leave this off if you watch streams while gaming.

title: Network commands
desc: Flush DNS, TCP auto-tuning normal, Receive Side Scaling on, forced HPET timer removed.

title: Nagle's algorithm off
desc: Sends small packets immediately. Lowers ping in TCP-based games such as MMOs.

title: Network adapter power saving off
desc: Energy Efficient Ethernet, Green Ethernet and adapter power saving off. The connection drops for a few seconds.

title: Scan drives for errors
desc: SMART health check and file system scan on every drive, with automatic repair.

title: Optimize drives
desc: TRIM on SSDs and NVMe. Defrag on hard drives only when they need it.

title: Update hardware drivers
desc: Installs chipset, network, audio and other OEM driver updates from Windows Update. GPU drivers are skipped.

title: Windows Disk Cleanup
desc: Runs Disk Cleanup on a safe set of categories, for up to 6 minutes. Previous Windows installs are kept.

title: Windows Update download cache
desc: Clears downloaded update files and the Delivery Optimization cache.

title: Deep clean the component store
desc: Runs DISM component cleanup to remove old Windows update files, with live progress. Can take a long time, so it is off by default. Windows also runs this on its own during maintenance.
